commands.command: Read-only search and source review of Python filesystem mutation calls and EngineClient compatibility checks in repopact/*.py
commands.summary: Repository-writing entry points include adopt_repo.adopt, doctor.fix, init_repo.bootstrap, new.new_markdown, plan_import.import_plan, takeover.takeover, verification.record_evidence, and generate_spec.write_spec. Existing one-shot check_compatibility calls occur before some writes but use a separate process and do not establish admission for a later process. Takeover separately validates before Python-side rewrites/removal. Low-level writers also exist below CLI entry points. The audit records these as implementation requirements, not as presently enforced admission. Independent Python-authoritative and release/platform writers require an explicit boundary classification.
